purpose: A deterministic, ordered terminal action policy for frozen Score Policy 2.1.0. Does not replace or edit historical 2.0/2.0.1 artifacts.

signal.meaning: Already-classified signal from Signal Policy after hard filters and Security Gate signal cap.

eventClass.meaning: Explicitly normalized event class; see context mapping, never inferred from missing fields.

risk.source: Risk Policy 1.0; unresolved generation rejects the candidate.

priorValidation.source: priorValidation Policy 1.0; explicit human authority only.

eventClassMapping.determinism: The adapter is selected explicitly by Contract/package version. Event Policy 1.0 canonicalization is required before Contract 2.1.2 mapping.

actions.ignore: Candidate was hard-filtered upstream and is not admitted to actionable Radar output.
actions.watch: Retain for monitoring; no immediate review/test/adoption instruction.
actions.read: Read and assess the evidence; no trial/adoption instruction.
actions.test: Run a bounded, reversible evaluation in a safe environment before use.
actions.adopt: Incorporate into the tracked environment only after explicit independent human validation.

precedence.when: risk == high AND signal IN [medium, low]
signal == high AND eventClass == FIRST_DISCOVERY AND actionability >= 7 AND relevanceScore >= 8
signal == high AND eventClass == FIRST_DISCOVERY AND NOT P05 AND impact >= 6
signal == high AND eventClass == FIRST_DISCOVERY AND NOT P05 AND impact < 6
precedence.rationale: A first discovery that fails the explicit P05 minimum relevance/actionability condition and P06 material-impact read condition is READ; newness alone never produces TEST.

precedence.when: signal == high AND eventClass == OTHER AND priorValidation == true AND risk == low AND relevanceLevel == DIRECT AND relevanceScore >= 8 AND actionability >= 7 AND confidence >= 6 AND impact >= 7
signal == high AND no prior high rule matched AND actionability >= 5
signal == high AND no prior high rule matched AND actionability < 5
signal == medium AND actionability >= 6 AND relevanceScore >= 7
signal == medium AND no prior medium rule matched AND impact >= 5
signal == medium AND no prior medium rule matched AND impact < 5

invariants: ADOPT is impossible without priorValidation=true, risk=low, direct relevance and all frozen guard thresholds.
FIRST_DISCOVERY and VERSION_RELEASE classes never ADOPT.
Action policy does not recalculate scores, direct bonus, modifiers, filters, gates, or signals.
A missing/invalid required input returns unresolved validation error; it is never silently defaulted.

upstreamBoundary.duplicate: Score Engine hard filter. Adapter supplies signal=filtered; Action Policy does not inspect duplicate.
upstreamBoundary.securityGate: Security Gate independently filters SEC/UNRELATED and caps ECOSYSTEM_RELEVANT high signal. Action Policy consumes resulting signal only.
upstreamBoundary.signal: Signal Policy classifies final score and applies Security Gate cap; Action Policy does not recalculate it.
upstreamBoundary.directBonus: Score formula only; not an action input.
upstreamBoundary.modifier: Score Policy 2.0.1 resolver only; not an action input.

historicalReplayAdapter: Historical Score 2.0.1 rows are adapted from their serialized signal/eventType and unchanged dimensions. risk=normal and priorValidation=false are preserved as fixture values only, not treated as provenance.

revisionSummary.semanticChange: No score or numeric threshold change. TEST remains permitted on first discovery only when explicit P05 relevance and actionability gates pass (unless earlier terminal risk rule applies).

p07Adjudication.rationale: P05 requires relevanceScore>=8 and actionability>=7. Actionability 7/10 alone establishes feasibility but not relevance/value; no evidence justifies preserving a first-discovery TEST where relevance is 1/3/5. Legacy engine branch is not policy authority. P07 remains default READ.

boundaryVerification.reportedFiveFailures: false positives from erroneous P11/P12 threshold implementation; see reconciliation artifact.
